$comment: IBK project manifest. To add a project: append an entry here, create images/projects/<slug>/ with hero.jpg + numbered gallery photos (01.jpg, 02.jpg, …), copy projects/_template.html to projects/<slug>.html and change the slug on line 2. See MAINTAINING.md for the full walkthrough.

card_text.id: Design-build penuh — struktur, arsitektur, dan MEP lengkap dalam satu kontrak bersama Beta Design Studio.
card_text.en: Full design-build — structure, architecture, and full MEP under one contract with system delivered with Beta Design Studio.

intro.id: Proyek residensial mewah IBK di PIK2, Jakarta — rumah tiga lantai yang dirancang bersama Beta Design Studio. Setiap spesifikasi dipilih untuk bertahan puluhan tahun: beton K-400, waterproofing tiga lapis, WPC dinding dan plafon, lantai sintered stone, dan finishing bebas cat sepenuhnya.
intro.en: IBK's luxury residential flagship in PIK2, Jakarta — a three-storey home designed with Beta Design Studio. Every specification chosen to last decades: K-400 concrete, triple-layer waterproofing, WPC wall and ceiling, sintered stone floors, and a fully zero-paint finish.

card_text.id: Proyek merek hotel internasional pertama IBK — Fire Suppression, Elektrikal, dan HVAC sesuai standar Hilton Hotels & Resorts.
card_text.en: IBK's first international hotel brand project — Fire Suppression, Electrical, and HVAC delivered to Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand standard.

intro.id: Proyek merek hotel internasional pertama IBK. Membuktikan kemampuan kami memenuhi standar teknik dan keselamatan kebakaran kelas dunia — membuka pintu ke jaringan proyek Marriott, IHG, dan Accor.
intro.en: IBK's first international hotel brand project. Demonstrates our capability to meet global brand engineering and fire safety standards — opening the door to the Marriott, IHG, and Accor pipeline.

card_text.id: Pabrik topi berskala industri dengan struktur pre-engineered steel, pondasi berat, dan MEP lengkap. Program mengikuti milestone pemasangan mesin klien.
card_text.en: Industrial-scale hat factory with pre-engineered steel structure, heavy-duty foundations, and full MEP. Programme built around client machinery installation milestones.

intro.id: Pengerjaan penuh untuk pabrik manufaktur kelas industri — kontrak langsung tanpa perantara. Menyesuaikan program konstruksi dengan tanggal pemasangan mesin dan mulai produksi klien.
intro.en: Full-scope delivery for an industrial manufacturing facility — directly contracted, no intermediary. Programme built around client machinery installation and production start dates.
